C-STATS-DASH-PUSH.IntentSummary: Implement the approved spec: one best-effort dashboard push per counted gateway event (mark.update_check / mark.update_pkg with props), off by absent DASH_COLLECT_KEY, responses byte-unchanged, counting and /stats untouched.

T-001.Title: The pushDash helper and its two call sites

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: worker.mjs gains DASH_COLLECT_URL ('https://dash.xronocode.com/api/v1/collect') and pushDash(ctx, env, name, props): returns immediately when env.DASH_COLLECT_KEY is absent or empty; otherwise ctx.waitUntil one fetch POST with headers content-type application/json and x-collect-key, body JSON {events:[{id: crypto.randomUUID(), name, ts: Date.now(), session: 'gateway', props}]} with the response body cancelled and every error swallowed (try/catch plus .catch). handleFeed calls pushDash(ctx, env, 'mark.update_check', { os, from }) right after count(); handlePkg calls pushDash(ctx, env, 'mark.update_pkg', { platform, version }). Counting validation, redirects, datapoints and logging are otherwise byte-identical. The contract header is amended (PURPOSE/SCOPE sentence for the push, MODULE_MAP grows DASH_COLLECT_URL and pushDash, LINKS add C-STATS-DASH-PUSH, VERSION bump to 1.3.0 with a CHANGE_SUMMARY entry).

tests/tools/stats-gateway.test.mjs grows: (a) a stubbed-fetch recorder asserting for a valid /feed exactly one dashboard POST with the exact event object (name mark.update_check, session gateway, props os/from, ts within tolerance) and the x-collect-key header equal to a fake fixture key; (b) the same for /pkg with mark.update_pkg and platform/version; (c) off-by-absence: unset and empty DASH_COLLECT_KEY produce zero dashboard fetches while the AE write still happens; (d) swallow-on-failure: a rejecting or non-2XX dashboard stub leaves the 302 response byte-identical and logs nothing; (e) the secrets-name-only scan's allowed list gains DASH_COLLECT_KEY (fixture values obviously fake, non-hex where applicable). The file's governed header bumps VERSION and CHANGE_SUMMARY. Existing 48 tests keep their expectations unchanged.

T-003.Title: README disclosure and setup; graph/verification amendments

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: README: the data-flow/privacy sentences disclose the dashboard push (aggregate dimensions only, owner's own dashboard, best-effort, off without the key); a short setup subsection documents issuing the site ingest key in the dashboard and setting it as the worker secret DASH_COLLECT_KEY; every STATS_API_TOKEN instruction is removed (no Cloudflare API token is documented anywhere). .grace/graph/features.xml M-071: PURPOSE/Summary mention the dashboard push. .grace/verification/features.xml V-M-071: a push scenario mirroring T-002's pins; the owner-side live check (first mark.update_check events visible in the dashboard after the key is set) recorded as pending post-deploy evidence.

Verification.Command: python3 -c "import xml.dom.minidom; xml.dom.minidom.parse('.grace/graph/features.xml'); xml.dom.minidom.parse('.grace/verification/features.xml')" && grep -c "DASH_COLLECT_KEY" tools/stats-gateway/README.md && ! grep -q "STATS_API_TOKEN" tools/stats-gateway/README.md

C-4.Situation: The full 48-plus suite and the secrets scan after the change.
C-4.Expected: Green; the scan allows only the secret NAMES incl. DASH_COLLECT_KEY; README names no Cloudflare API token for reading.
